description: The restaurants critics agree on in a US city (Michelin, Eater 38, The Infatuation), for any meal and any party of two or more, with vibe tags (fancy/chill, quiet/loud, quick/long, classic/new) and how to book where we know it. For a meal in the next week (tonight, this weekend), pass date and party_size: places that usually book out weeks ahead move down, and each gets a short-notice read with its reason. Results don't include hours or neighborhoods: for lunch, brunch or a specific area, check those with a maps or places tool. Use the returned ids with create_restaurant_vote.
name: find_restaurants
title: Find restaurants
